scope_audits.integration_width_caution: 35/35/160 km are transport-integration widths, not current widths. Ombai geographic width is discussed as 37 km in paragraph 8, while transport calculations use 35 km. Neither provides a uniform current footprint.
remaining_gates: Assess full passage/depth coverage and reversals; no complete network asserted.
Recover axes and scientifically justify branch gates before measuring lengths.
Keep upstream and downstream transport budgets separate; no sum over graph edges.
Review original processing and observation gaps before new derived dimensions.
scope_audits.source_access: Publisher Introduction paragraphs 3–8, Tables 1–2 and section 2.2 read; no figure, field or transport time-series digitized.
scope_audits.source_time_caution: Abstract mentions January 2003; Table 1 explicitly reports 2004–2006 averages. Individual mooring deployment dates differ, including an August 2003 Ombai deployment. Preserve these distinctions.
scope_audits.summary: Selected western/eastern inflow and three main exit pathways represented as twelve conceptual nodes and fourteen connections. Three exit transport means retain 2004–2006 support, processing-choice intervals and eight published first-deployment mooring positions. No geographic network edges, full system length, current width, annual extrema or instantaneous one-way-flow claim.
